text:
Sea Limited's net income attributable to ordinary shareholders was **US$1,578.1 million (approximately US$1.58 billion)** for FY2025, up sharply from US$444.3 million in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-70].

This reflects income before income tax and share of results of equity investees of about US$2.3 billion, less an income tax expense of US$651.1 million [Sea, FY2025, p.101]. Basic earnings per share for 2025 was US$2.65, compared with US$0.77 in 2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-70].

answer:
Sea Limited's net income attributable to ordinary shareholders was **US$1,578.1 million (approximately US$1.58 billion)** for FY2025, up sharply from US$444.3 million in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-70].

This reflects income before income tax and share of results of equity investees of about US$2.3 billion, less an income tax expense of US$651.1 million [Sea, FY2025, p.101]. Basic earnings per share for 2025 was US$2.65, compared with US$0.77 in 2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-70].
